name: Sunshine Baseball League
mission: Sunshine Ballpark's mission is to offer sports programs and educational opportunities that help young people, especially those who are disadvantaged or facing physical, developmental and other challenges, learn critical life lessons.
welcome: The non-profit Sunshine Board welcomes all to "protect and enjoy" the ballpark with its turf fields and playground at 1200 Wicklow Drive in Fredericksburg.
about: Sunshine Baseball League offers boys and girls ages 8 to 18 the opportunity to play ball from June 1 to mid-August. We serve Fredericksburg and surrounding communities.

rulebook.note: Sunshine house rules come first. Where a house rule doesn't cover something, Little League rules apply.
